title: Utility Software
purpose: Preserve original Code First and its answer, original exam questions and answers, previous-learning prompt, old visuals and challenge; bank replacements are teacher-preview only inside You Do. Other phases and ordinary student URLs are untouched.

code_first.code:
originalKB = 500
compressedKB = 300
savedKB = originalKB - compressedKB
print(savedKB)
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
code_first.a: Initially 500−300=200 KB saved: (200/500)×100=40% of the original. Changing compressedKB to 250 means 500−250=250 KB saved, or (250/500)×100=50%. The code calculates savings; it does not compress data.

original_exam_questions: State a purpose of encryption utility software. [2 marks]
Converts readable data into ciphertext to restrict unauthorised reading.
Explain why defragmentation can improve HDD access. [3 marks]
It places related fragments closer together, reducing mechanical seek time.
Explain why lossless compression matters for source code. [3 marks]
Original bytes must be recovered exactly; lossy removal could corrupt instructions.

stretch.task: Display both savedKB and percentage saved for 500→300 KB.

mastery.task: Design a function computing percentage saving while safely handling original=0 and impossible compressed>original input.
mastery.hint: Validate before dividing; return meaningful status.
mastery.answer: 500→300 gives 40%; 100→100 gives 0%; original0 rejected/handled; compressed600 for original500 flagged as invalid.
